phase_convention: delta=unwrap(arg(1+i*kappa*f))/2 anchored at threshold; eta retained
winding_scope: Native S determines delta modulo pi. Threshold-anchored nearest-branch unwrapping does not determine winding between nodes; no-crossing is not a no-pole theorem. Circular and complex-S separations remove arbitrary pi shifts.
comparison_scope: Native energy samples; reference curves are not extrapolated; no fit or exact 6-percent target.
reference_scope: PDF marker centers and displayed phenomenological curves; experimental uncertainties/covariance were not imported.
baseline_scope: Saved same-scattering-model C control, if available; projection and continuation objective need not coincide with the joint representatives.
